o1.biggest_strength: It directly targets the real pain points in your data, especially tier-3 COD risk and order-status chat load, with usable flows and templates.
o1.biggest_mistake: It misclassifies the prepaid switch as Utility in one template and misses the full after-hours button set you were hoping for.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Make the prepaid nudge fully Marketing, tighten a few numbers, and add the richer after-hours automation with track/size/exchange/COD buttons.

o2.biggest_strength: It uses your data sharply to create differentiated flows by risk band, gets the WhatsApp categories right, and turns the RTO maths into clear action.
o2.biggest_mistake: The prepaid ₹30 incentive is an assumption introduced without owner approval, and the holdout note on unconfirmed orders is a bit risky operationally.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Keep the same structure but remove or justify the ₹30 offer with your margin reality and add a fuller after-hours button flow.

reason: Output 2 is the one I'd rather pay for because it is more precise on categories, sharper on tier-based action, and stronger on the weekly scorecard tied to decisions. Output 1 is good and practical, but Output 2 feels more aligned to the signals in my data and needs less fixing.
